rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2-4 and Tables 3, 5, 6 report the authors' own downscaling experiment combining SMAP 9-km soil moisture, Planet SuperDove 3-m imagery, machine learning and CDF matching, validated against Yanco in situ stations and HDAS intensive sampling in the Yanco region, Australia, 2021.
rows.notes: The study is a remote-sensing methods paper producing 3-m surface soil moisture maps and assessing their accuracy against in situ measurements (RMSE reduced ~0.01 cm3/cm3 vs SMAP). It does not report any result on soil management or soil quality maintenance; applications to precision agriculture, irrigation and water resources management are mentioned only as potential uses in the Introduction, Discussion and Conclusions. Mapping soil moisture is at most a precondition for the claimed soil-management/soil-quality effect, so Q2 is 'no' and upstream is set. The study does qualitatively note that downscaled maps captured wetter irrigated fields versus non-irrigated ones (Section 4.3), but this is an observation of moisture patterns, not evidence of supporting soil quality maintenance.

notes: Full text appears complete though the PDF-to-text conversion has duplicated/interleaved lines on several pages; no content appears missing. The study concerns soil moisture mapping, not soil health or soil quality, so the review's citation attributes an effect the study does not test.
